# VitePress

Vue/Vite static site generator. Pages are markdown-it Markdown compiled as Vue components; config is a JS/TS module.

## Detect

- Repo: a `.vitepress/` directory holding `config.{js,ts,mjs,mts}` (usually `docs/.vitepress/`) and a `vitepress` dependency. The folder containing `.vitepress/` is the project root; `package.json` scripts run `vitepress dev <root>`.
- Live site: `<meta name="generator" content="VitePress ...">`, `VPContent` / `VPDoc` classes.
- `.vitepress/` beats everything else. A `.vuepress/` folder or `vuepress` dependency means VuePress (`mint migrate --from vuepress`).

## Get the source

### From the repo

- Pages live in `srcDir` (default: project root), minus `srcExclude` globs. `<srcDir>/public/` holds static files.
- Read the whole config module plus every file it imports (sidebar/nav helpers, per-locale configs, `.vitepress/theme/index.*`).
- No built-in versioning. i18n: `locales` keys map to folders (`root` is the unprefixed default, `fr` serves `/fr/`).
- Dynamic routes: `[param].md` plus `[param].paths.{js,ts}` generate one page per path. Data loaders: `*.data.{js,ts}`.
- Build: `vitepress build <root>`, output in `.vitepress/dist/` (`mint migrate --topic discovery`, From the repo).

### From an export

None; the site is built from the repo.

### From the live site

Follow the "Edit this page" link (`themeConfig.editLink.pattern`) or the footer/nav GitHub link to the repo and fetch raw `.md` from there. Rendered HTML is the fallback.

## Config → docs.json

| VitePress                                                                                                                               | docs.json                                                                       |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `title`                                                                                                                                 | `name`                                                                          |
| `description`                                                                                                                           | `description`                                                                   |
| `themeConfig.logo` (string, `{ src }`, `{ light, dark }`)                                                                               | `logo` (string or `{ light, dark }`)                                            |
| `head` `link rel="icon"`                                                                                                                | `favicon`                                                                       |
| `head` gtag / GTM scripts                                                                                                               | `integrations.ga4.measurementId` / `integrations.gtm.tagId`                     |
| `head` `meta` tags                                                                                                                      | `seo.metatags`                                                                  |
| `appearance: 'dark'`                                                                                                                    | `appearance.default: "dark"`                                                    |
| `appearance: false` / `'force-dark'` / `'force-auto'`                                                                                   | `appearance.default` `light` / `dark` / `system` plus `appearance.strict: true` |
| `lastUpdated: true`                                                                                                                     | `metadata.timestamp: true`                                                      |
| `markdown.theme`                                                                                                                        | `styling.codeblocks`                                                            |
| `themeConfig.socialLinks`                                                                                                               | `footer.socials` (`twitter` → `x`); `{ svg }` icons: drop and report            |
| `themeConfig.nav`, `themeConfig.sidebar`                                                                                                | `navigation` (see Navigation)                                                   |
| `locales`                                                                                                                               | `navigation.languages`                                                          |
| `base`, `cleanUrls`, `rewrites`                                                                                                         | no field; see URLs and redirects                                                |
| `themeConfig.footer`, `siteTitle`, `titleTemplate`                                                                                      | drop and report                                                                 |
| `themeConfig.editLink`, `search` (local or Algolia), `carbonAds`, `outline`, `aside`, `docFooter`, `*Label` strings, `gradedContainers` | drop and report                                                                 |
| `markdown.lineNumbers`                                                                                                                  | drop; add `lines` to each fence if the user wants it site-wide                  |
| `markdown.container` labels, `markdown.math`                                                                                            | drop (Mintlify renders `$` math natively)                                       |
| `markdown.config` / `preConfig` (`md.use(...)`)                                                                                         | find each plugin's syntax in the content and convert it; report each plugin     |
| `vite`, `vue`, build hooks (`transformHead`, `transformPageData`, `buildEnd`, ...)                                                      | drop and report what each one did                                               |

## Navigation

Full reference: https://vitepress.dev/reference/default-theme-sidebar and https://vitepress.dev/reference/default-theme-nav

- `themeConfig.sidebar` array: each top-level `{ text, items }` → a group, in order; nested `items` → nested groups. Each `{ text, link }` → a page.
- Resolve `link`: prepend the enclosing `base` (a nested `base` overrides its parent's), strip leading `/`, `.md`, `.html`; a trailing `/` means `<dir>/index`.
- `text` that differs from the page H1 → `sidebarTitle`.
- A group with its own `link` → that page becomes the group's `root`.
- `collapsed` on nested groups: `true` → `expanded: false`; `false` or unset → `expanded: true` (VitePress opens them). On top-level groups it has no Mintlify equivalent: report `collapsed: true`.
- Multi-sidebar object (`{ '/guide/': [...], '/api/': { base, items } }`) → one tab per key; label from the `nav` item that links into that path.
- `nav`: links into a sidebar key → those tabs; dropdown `items` → that tab's `menu`; external links (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Structure rules). Drop `activeMatch`, `target`, `rel`, `noIcon`.
- External `link` items inside the sidebar: report them; do not invent pages.
- Pages no sidebar lists were reachable only by URL (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Structure rules).

## Content conversion

Syntax reference: https://vitepress.dev/guide/markdown. `:::` containers (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Admonitions); GitHub alerts (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, GitHub alerts); callout titles (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Components).

| VitePress                                                          | Mintlify                                                                               |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Container registered in `markdown.container.customContainers`      | the callout closest in meaning; report                                                 |
| `::: details Title` (`{open}`)                                     | `<Accordion title="Title">` (`defaultOpen`); untitled → `title="Details"`              |
| `{no-title}` on a container                                        | drop the attribute                                                                     |
| `::: raw`                                                          | remove the wrapper lines                                                               |
| `::: v-pre`, `<span v-pre>`                                        | unwrap; the `{{ }}` inside was shown literally, so keep it as literal text             |
| ` ```js-vue ` (any `-vue` suffix)                                  | plain language; substitute the `{{ }}` values inside                                   |
| `::: code-group` with ` ```js [config.js] ` fences                 | `<CodeGroup>`; each `[label]` becomes the fence title; unlabeled fence → language name |
| `> [!DANGER]`                                                      | `<Danger>`                                                                             |
| ` ```js{1,4-6} `                                                   | ` ```js highlight={1,4-6} `                                                            |
| `:line-numbers` / `:line-numbers=N` / `:no-line-numbers`           | `lines` / `lines` (start offset lost: report) / drop                                   |
| `// [!code ++]`, `// [!code --]`                                   | keep                                                                                   |
| `// [!code focus]`, `// [!code focus:N]`                           | remove the comment; add those lines to `focus={...}`                                   |
| `// [!code highlight]`                                             | remove the comment; add the line to `highlight={...}`                                  |
| `// [!code error]`, `// [!code warning]`                           | remove the comment; report                                                             |
| ` ```ts twoslash `                                                 | keep `twoslash`                                                                        |
| `<<< @/path/file.ts{2 ts:line-numbers} [Title]`, `<<< file#region` | `mint migrate --topic conversion`, Code imports; `@` is `srcDir`                       |
| `<!--@include: ./part.md-->`                                       | `mint migrate --topic conversion`, Reusable content                                    |
| `<!--@include: ./part.md{3,}-->`, `#region`, `#heading-anchor`     | inline the selected lines                                                              |
| `[[toc]]`                                                          | delete                                                                                 |
| `:tada:` emoji shortcodes                                          | the Unicode emoji                                                                      |
| `$...$`, `$$...$$` (with `markdown.math`)                          | keep                                                                                   |
| ` ```mermaid ` (from a mermaid plugin)                             | keep                                                                                   |

Vue in markdown (https://vitepress.dev/guide/using-vue):

- `{{ expr }}`, `$frontmatter.x`, `$params.x` (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Template tags).
- `<script setup>`, `<script>`, `<style>` blocks: delete; report styles that mattered.
- `<Badge type="tip|info|warning|danger" text="x" />` or with children → `<Badge color="...">x</Badge>`, closest color.
- `<ClientOnly>`: unwrap. `v-if` / `v-for` / `v-pre` on HTML: render the static result.
- Global components (registered in `.vitepress/theme/index.*` `enhanceApp`) and imported `.vue` files (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Components). `VPTeamMembers` → `<Card>`s in `<Columns>`.

Frontmatter (https://vitepress.dev/reference/frontmatter-config); `title` and `description` (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Frontmatter):

| VitePress                                                                                                            | Mintlify                                                                                                                                                            |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `title` (sets only `<title>`; the visible H1 is in the body)                                                         | `title` from the body H1                                                                                                                                            |
| `layout: home` with `hero` / `features`                                                                              | `mode: custom`; hero `name`/`text`/`tagline` as heading and paragraph, `actions` as links or `<Card>`s, each feature as `<Card title href>` in `<Columns cols={3}>` |
| `layout: page`                                                                                                       | `mode: frame`                                                                                                                                                       |
| `sidebar: false`                                                                                                     | `mode: center`                                                                                                                                                      |
| `aside: false`                                                                                                       | `mode: wide`                                                                                                                                                        |
| `head` `og:image` meta                                                                                               | `"og:image"`                                                                                                                                                        |
| `outline`, `prev`, `next`, `editLink`, `lastUpdated`, `footer`, `navbar`, `pageClass`, `titleTemplate`, other `head` | drop and report                                                                                                                                                     |

## Assets

- `<srcDir>/public/` is served at the site root (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Images and files).
- Asset references never include `base`; do not add it.

## URLs and redirects

- `cleanUrls: false` (default): `guide/foo.md` serves `/guide/foo.html` (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Redirects).
- `cleanUrls: true`: `/guide/foo`, matching Mintlify paths.
- `index.md` serves its folder URL (`/guide/`); `index.md` at the root serves `/`.
- `base: '/docs/'` prefixes every URL. If the Mintlify site keeps that subpath, keep URLs under it; otherwise see `mint migrate --topic navigation`, Redirects.
- `rewrites` change the URL away from the file path: place each file at its rewritten path so the URL is unchanged. Relative links in rewritten pages are already written against rewritten paths.
- Locale pages serve under `/<key>/`.
- Old URL list: `.vitepress/dist/**/*.html` from the build, or the live `sitemap.xml`.
- VitePress heading slugs (and any custom `markdown.anchor.slugify`) differ from Mintlify's (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Heading IDs).

## Known gaps

Report each of these when present:

- Vue components, composables (`useData`), and custom theme layouts.
- Data loaders and dynamic routes (pages must be materialized).
- Local search and Algolia DocSearch settings.
- Footer message/copyright, edit links, prev/next overrides, outline levels, carbon ads.
- Code line-number offsets, `[!code error|warning]` coloring.
- Collapsible top-level sidebar groups.
- Custom markdown-it plugins and Vite plugins.
